_comment: Released SemanticBridge recipe: 6 m column window at a 4 cm input voxel.
The window and the voxel are sized together. With cover tiling the effective per-block
density is block_size / window^2, so widening the window on its own thins every block;
widening the voxel with it keeps points per block roughly constant. At 20480 points this
recipe holds about 569 pts/m^2 against 808 available (a 1.4x subsample).
This is the configuration the released checkpoint was trained with; see BRIDGE.md.
name: bridge_w6
